name: io.github.madhav037/shared-memory
title: Shared Memory
description: A memory server every member's coding agent reads and writes, with a console to govern it.

server_host.description: Host name of your team's own Shared Memory server, without https://.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Your personal token, from your team's owner or the console's Connect your agent page.

headers.name: X-Shared-Memory-Project
headers.description: The project ID the console shows for your repository's project. Leave empty outside a project.

headers.name: X-Shared-Memory-Repository
headers.description: The repository's name within that project.
